navaid.name: Penlee Lifeboat Station
navaid.description: The Penlee live boat was stationed here from 1913 until 1983. The volunteer crews showed their bravery, endurance and seafaring skills in often hazardous rescues. The station will always be remembered for the tragic loss of the Solomon Browne (19.121981).

navaid.name: Godrevy Island
navaid.description: Godrevy Lighthouse was built by Trinity House in 1859 marking a dangerous reef off St. Ives called the Stones; the light was moved to an adjacent steel structure in 2012 Godrevy Lighthouse was modernised in 1995 when it was converted to solar powered ope
